name: Still Water
description: An album for meditation, breathwork and rest: a paced breathing guide, singing bowls, chant, sea, rain and forest, a body scan that moves around your head, and gentle binaural drones for sleep. Each piece is a whole session of four to seven minutes, laid out once on a song timeline with an arrival, a settled middle and a quiet ending. Slow tempos, long envelopes and nothing sudden.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Breath Guide
sketches.description: Paced breathing at six breaths a minute for about seven and a half minutes. Breathe in for four seconds while the chord swells, and out for six while it fades. A soft bowl marks each new breath; the chord brightens as you deepen, and in the final rest the breath slowly lengthens to twelve seconds.
sketches.source:
setcpm(6)

// One cycle is one breath of ten seconds: in for four, out for six
song("arrive@3 breathe@12 deepen@12 breathe'@12 rest@6", "once")

// In the final rest the breath lengthens towards twelve seconds
tempomap("0:6 39:6 45:5")

// Breathe in as the chord swells, breathe out as it fades
// It opens up while you deepen, and rises an octave on the second round
breath: note("<[d3,a3,f#4] [b2,f#3,d4] [g2,d3,b3] [a2,e3,c#4]>")
  .struct("x@2 ~@3")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .attack(4).sustain(1).release(6)
  .lpf(bysec("deepen:1400 *:900")).room(.7).size(.9)
  .gain(bysec("rest:.12 *:.2"))
  .variant(x => x.add(12).gain(.14))
  .exceptSections("arrive")

// A soft bowl at the start of every breath, once the guide begins
bowl: note("d4").s("sine").fm(1.5).fmh(2.76)
  .decay(6).sustain(0).release(6).space("hall").gain(.18)
  .exceptSections("arrive")

// A low drone and the sea far away, there from the first moment
drone: note("[d2,a2]").slow(4).s("sine").attack(4).sustain(1).release(6)
  .gain(bysec("arrive:.12 *:.16"))
surf: s("surf").intensity(bysec("arrive:.4 rest:.2 *:.3")).distance(4).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Singing Bowls
sketches.description: A six-minute sound bath: the room gathers, FM singing bowls are struck slowly and drift across the stereo field, a second round answers a fifth higher, the great bowl leads a deep round, and the hum fades into stillness.

sketches.name: Ocean Breath
sketches.description: Waves on a quiet shore with a warm pad that opens and closes like the tide through every section. A tide of about four minutes that comes back around: the water rises, the light on it lingers, then the sea goes slack and darker before the next ebb. Let your breathing follow the water.
sketches.source:
setcpm(50/4)

// One tide of about four minutes, then it comes back around
song("ebb@8 flow@16 flow'@16 slack@8")

// The shore rises with the tide
surf: s("surf").slow(8).intensity(bysec("ebb:.3 flow:.45 flow':.5 slack:.35")).gain(.32)
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(bysec("flow':.3 *:.2")).gain(.06)

// A warm pad whose filter opens and closes once over every section
pad: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [d3,f3,a3,c4] [bb2,d3,f3,a3] [c3,e3,g3,c4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.25)
  .attack(3).release(4)
  .lpf(env("400 1200 400", "section")).room(.8).size(.9)
  .gain(bysec("ebb:.1 *:.16"))

// A few clear notes, like light on the water
// They settle into D minor at slack water, and their echoes linger on the second flow
shimmer: n("<4 ~ ~ 2 ~ ~ 6 ~>").scale(bysec("slack:D:minor *:F:major")).transpose(12)
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(4).decay(2).sustain(0).release(2)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.4).room(.7).gain(.14)
  .variant(x => x.delayfeedback(.6).room(.85))
  .exceptSections("ebb")

sketches.name: Temple Dawn
sketches.description: Night to sunrise in a little under four and a half minutes. A reed drone holds through the dark, a choir breathes open fifths, distant bells sound, the chant returns an octave higher as the birds wake, and everything slows as the sun comes up.
sketches.source:
setcpm(50/4)

// From night to sunrise
song("night@4 chant@16 bells@8 chant'@16 sunrise@8", "once")

// The second chant slows as the sun comes up
tempomap("0:12.5 36:12.5 44:10")

// The choir breathes slow, open chords; the second chant rises an octave
// Each chord lasts two cycles, so each vowel is written twice to change with it
choir: note("<[c3,g3,c4] [c3,g3,d4] [c3,f3,c4] [c3,g3,c4]>").slow(2)
  .s("choir").syl("<oh oh ah ah oo oo oh oh>")
  .attack(2).release(3).space("church")
  .gain(bysec("sunrise:.24 *:.32"))
  .variant(x => x.add(12).gain(.24))
  .sections("chant sunrise")

// A reed drone that never moves, quiet through the night
drone: note("[c2,g2]").slow(8).s("sawtooth").timbre("reed")
  .lpf(500).attack(3).sustain(1).release(4)
  .gain(bysec("night:.08 *:.14"))

// Distant bells
bells: note("<g4 ~ ~ ~ c5 ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(3).fmh(2.41)
  .decay(4).sustain(0).release(4).space("church").gain(.14)
  .sections("bells sunrise")

// Birds outside the walls wake with the bells
birds: s("bird").slow(4).azimuth(-60).distance(8).occlude(.4)
  .gain(bysec("sunrise:.22 *:.16"))
  .sections("bells chant' sunrise")

sketches.name: So Hum
sketches.description: A mantra meditation of about four and three quarter minutes: a single voice sings 'so' on the in-breath and 'hum' on the out-breath, over a ringing drone. It chants, breathes softly, chants again, then falls silent: keep repeating it inwardly until the voice returns.

sketches.name: Forest Clearing
sketches.description: Headphones on: you sit in a clearing by a stream through a morning of about four minutes that comes back around. Birds are placed around you, insects wake in the grass, and a slow wooden flute plays its tune twice, the second time an octave higher.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

// A morning in the clearing, then round again
song("dawn@8 morning@16 flute@16 flute'@16 noon@8")

// The stream and the breeze
stream: s("stream").slow(4).azimuth(-30).distance(2).gain(.26)
breeze: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(bysec("noon:.3 *:.2")).gain(.08)

// Birds around the clearing, one wandering slowly overhead once the day begins
wren: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(60).distance(4).gain(bysec("dawn:.2 noon:.2 *:.3"))
thrush: s("bird").slow(5).azimuth(saw.range(-150, 150).slow(16)).elevation(30).distance(6).posglide(.4).gain(.24)
  .exceptSections("dawn")
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(120).distance(3).gain(bysec("noon:.16 *:.1"))
  .exceptSections("dawn")

// A slow wooden flute; the second time it sings an octave higher, a little quieter
flute: note("<[g4@3 a4] b4 [d5@3 b4] a4 [g4@3 e4] d4 ~ ~>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(4.5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.3).sustain(.6).release(1.2)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).room(.6).gain(.26)
  .variant(x => x.add(12).gain(.2))
  .sections("flute")

sketches.name: Rain Retreat
sketches.description: Rain on the roof of a quiet retreat, in a cycle of about three and three quarter minutes. Sparse piano notes fall into the reverb, turning to D minor for a darker interlude; a seeded random choice leaves a few out, and the second piano passage leaves out different ones. The rain eases as the sky clears.
sketches.source:
setcpm(56/4)

// Rain alone, piano, a darker interlude, piano again, then the sky clears
song("arrive@4 piano@16 interlude@8 piano'@16 clearing@8")

// Steady rain on the roof, easing as it clears
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(bysec("clearing:.25 *:.45")).gain(.3)

// Sparse piano notes, a few gently left out
// The primed passage is a seeded variant, so different notes are left out
piano: n("<[0 ~ 4 ~] [~ 2 ~ ~] [5 ~ ~ 4] [~ ~ 2 ~]>")
  .scale(bysec("interlude:D:minor *:F:major")).transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.25).seed("retreat")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(1.5).sustain(.1).release(2)
  .room(.7).size(.9).gain(.3)
  .exceptSections("arrive")

// Soft low chords holding everything together
const soft = x => x.s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(1).sustain(.5).release(3)
  .lpf(900).room(.6).gain(.2)

chords: soft(note("<[f2,c3,a3] [d2,a2,f3] [bb1,f2,d3] [c2,g2,e3]>"))
  .exceptSections("interlude")
dark: soft(note("<[d2,a2,f3] [bb1,f2,d3] [g1,d2,bb2] [a1,e2,c#3]>"))
  .sections("interlude")

sketches.name: Body Scan
sketches.description: Headphones on: a soft humming tone circles your head, one region of the body at a time, rising in pitch and height from your feet to the crown of your head. A small bell marks each new region, and the session ends in a slower rest. About five and a half minutes.

sketches.name: Delta Sleep
sketches.description: Headphones on: a binaural beat that starts at 4 Hz and steps down into the delta range at 2 Hz, over warm brown noise and a pad that barely moves. The tempo slows across the session and the drone fades away at the end. About seven minutes, for falling asleep.

sketches.name: Theta Drift
sketches.description: Headphones on: about seven minutes of deep meditation. The binaural beat arrives at 8 Hz, settles to 6 Hz in the theta range under slow choir chords and a stream, and rises to 10 Hz to bring you gently back. The choir answers itself an octave higher on each second drift. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.
